Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.transcribe_async(LiterLlm::CreateTranscriptionRequest.new(file: 'audio.mp3', model: 'whisper-1', response_format: 'verbose_json'))
puts result.text.inspect
puts result.segments.inspect
puts result.segments[0].id.inspect
```
